nodes.title: SU2 8.5 2-D RANS runs, team/B2/sim/cfd2d_section.py
nodes.where: team/B2/sim/out/cfd2d_results.json; INC_RANS Spalart-Allmaras fully turbulent, gmsh meshes 9k/18k/36k cells (refinement sqrt 2), quad boundary layer, far field 50 c
nodes.note: fully turbulent: no laminar separation bubble, so clmax and hinge moments bracket XFOIL rather than replace it; not compared with test data at this Re

nodes.title: Props and pod enter the stall trim as a CL-independent NP shift
nodes.text: The AVL model (wing + fins, props off, no pod) is run with its moment reference at x_cg + dprop, dprop = CL-B3-V-XNP-AERO - CL-B3-V-XNP (B3's Ribner prop and pod terms, 2.9 mm), and at the real CG height z_cg; the trimmed CLmax is then read directly at the CG point (no static-margin mapping)
nodes.basis: B3 treats the same terms as CL-independent and uses the same shift in its stall calc (verify_asdesigned.py stall_v); the pod carries no elevon and the first-stall strip (y 0.071 m) is the inboard elevon end, outside the pod's 0.07 m half-width

nodes.title: Full elevon travel up to VA 20.5 m/s
nodes.text: Elevon hinge moments: 25 deg at VA 20.5 m/s and <= 1/3 travel (8.33 deg) at VD
nodes.basis: params requirements.vd_ms note (D-50, F4 CR-F4-12): full travel to VA 20.5 m/s, <= 1/3 at VD held by the flight envelope

nodes.title: Grid uncertainty limit
nodes.text: A CFD number that drives a requirement must have a fine-grid GCI <= 5 %
nodes.basis: Roache GCI, Fs 1.25, three levels at r = sqrt 2 (SIM-TOOLS.md practice)

nodes.title: Discretisation acceptance rule
nodes.text: An XFOIL panel or AVL lattice value used for a requirement is accepted if the finest level run gives a value at least as favourable (the value used is conservative); the spread is reported
nodes.basis: clmax spreads 1.7 % (XFOIL 160-400 panels, monotone rising) and 1.6 % (AVL, non-monotone) exceed the 1 % used in R2; a conservative value is the professional fallback

nodes.title: Stall speed at the CG points with the CG height (D-62)
nodes.equation: CLmax = kd * bilinear(x_cg, z_cg; AVL critical-section grid run with Xref = x + dprop, Zref = z); Vs = sqrt(2 m g / (rho b c CLmax)); Re correction CLmax *= 1 + s (Re_s - Re_x)/1e5; Vtr = k Vs; SM_fwd = (Xnp_B3 - x_fwd)/c (B3 whole-aircraft NP, alpha 4 deg, CG height)

nodes.title: CR-B1-23: B1 vs B2 trimmed CLmax and NP, one modelling change per step
nodes.equation: W0 = B1 set-up in the B2 AVL model (x 0.0536, z 0.018, no props/pod, cm_t 0, B1 stall-Re clmax table) -> W1 B2 raw stall-Re table -> W2 B2 envelope -> W3 + viscous cm trim -> W4 + props/pod shift; repro = W0 / CLmax_B1 - 1; NP: props-off effective Xnp at CL 0.414 with z 0.0185 minus B1's Xnp (Zref 0.018); dprop_drift = |dprop used - (CL-B3-V-XNP-AERO - CL-B3-V-XNP)|

nodes.title: Stall at the forward CG if the boundary layer were turbulent from the LE
nodes.equation: CLmax' = CLmax_fwd * clmax_turb / clmax_free; Vs' = Vs_fwd sqrt(clmax_free / clmax_turb); clmax_turb = lowest converged XFOIL tripped clmax at Re 2.6e5 over the trip cases of turbulator.py (closure round; was the unconverged xtr 0.02 point 1.095) or SU2 SA L2 sweep max

nodes.title: Tripped stall and the 1.3 Vs gate at both CG limits, with the airspeed error (final re-run)
nodes.equation: Vs_trip = Vs sqrt(clmax_free / clmax_trip) at the forward (cg.x_range_m[0]) and aft (cg.x_range_m[1]) limits ; V_1.3 = f Vs_trip ; gate: V_1.3 + e <= AIRSPEED_MIN (transition_min_ms), e = requirements.airspeed_err_max_ms ; stall bound re-derived from the integer AIRSPEED_MIN: (AIRSPEED_MIN - e) / f

nodes.title: Second stall fallback (pre-computed, CDR-15 / CDR-AE-06)
nodes.text: AIRSPEED_MIN = AIRSPEED_CRUISE = 18 m/s with AIRSPEED_MAX 20 m/s, used if T-B2-STALL measures a gate-mass stall between 13.07 and 13.85 m/s. PROPOSED: AIRSPEED_MAX 20 needs A1 / C1 to accept 0.5 m/s to VA
nodes.basis: review/CDR-2026-11-13/CDR-aero.md CDR-AE-06; board decision B6 makes 17 the baseline (first fallback of D-96)

nodes.title: Stall the B6 baseline (17 m/s) and the second fallback (18 m/s) hold to
nodes.equation: Vs_keep = AIRSPEED_MIN / f ; clmax ratio covered = (Vs_free / Vs_keep)^2 ; third step = ceil(f x Vs_su2)

nodes.title: Elevon hinge moment per servo, VA full travel and VD 1/3 travel
nodes.equation: H = C_h q c^2 s; C_h(25) = XFOIL inviscid max (design), C_h(8.3) = interp of XFOIL inviscid max at 5 and 10 deg; T_servo = SF * max(H) * k_linkage (envelope: 25 deg to VA, 1/3 at VD); T_servo_vdfull = SF * H(25 deg, VD) * k_linkage (R-SERVO-TORQUE as written); ratio_visc = max(|C_h SU2 L2 alpha -4|, SU2 bound alpha 0) / C_h XFOIL inviscid

nodes.title: Gopalarathnam, Broughton, McGranahan, Selig, Design of Low Reynolds Number Airfoils with Trips, J. Aircraft 40(4), 2003
nodes.where: p. 770: XFOIL fixed transition assumes instantaneous transition and no device drag; trips often act downstream of the device. p. 771-773: 0.0135 in (0.343 mm) tape on a 12 in chord (k/c 0.00113), Re 1e5 / 3e5, upper surface only: at Re 3e5 net drag change -0.001..-0.002 at Cl 0-0.4 (SA7025), increase at Cl ~0.75 for 0.1c / 0.2c trips (loss of laminar run)
nodes.note: measured net trip effect (device + skin friction + bubble) at our k/c and Re; not the S5010

nodes.title: Device drag of the zigzag tape
nodes.text: dcd_dev = C_Dk (k/c) (u_k/V)^2 with C_Dk = 1.0 on the dynamic pressure at the tape top, u_k from a Pohlhausen (Lambda 0) laminar profile on XFOIL's Ue and delta* just ahead of the tape
nodes.basis: EST, pessimistic: a 2-D bluff step whose top is inside the layer; XFOIL carries no device drag (SRC-B2-TRIPS-GOPAL p. 770); the measured net effect of a 0.34 mm tape at Re 3e5 was -0.002..+ small, so the hand total (XFOIL laminar-run loss + this) is an upper bound

nodes.title: Turbulator: section ac shift, cruise drag and power, trip Reynolds number
nodes.equation: dcm/dcl = local least-squares slope of XFOIL cm(cl) within +/-0.15 at B3's rows (18 / 17 m/s / 1.3 Vs, gate mass, Re-interpolated 3.4-3.9e5); cd = cd_XFOIL(forced transition) + C_Dk (k/c)(u_k/V)^2; dD = q S dcd; dP = dD V x P_E1 / (D_E1 V); Re_k = u_k k / nu
